title: Rendezvous on the Shore
text: “Huh? Well, all right. It’s true I haven’t talked much with Imiya-chan.”
“Exactly. Otherwise it’s hard for me to suggest all sorts of fun things to Imiya-san. She seems to be the self-punishing type, someone who can’t forgive herself unless a kid like her is happy.”
“Well… if it’ll cheer Itsuki up, I don’t mind helping out, but is me looking after Imiya-chan really going to solve anything?”

Father didn’t seem to be catching on, I say. Mole was quite attached to Father, after all. It probably would do her good, seeing as she was practically kin to Mole. And so, while Ren, Itsuki, and Wolf tackled the dungeon on Cal Mira Island, the rest of us decided to combine our own leveling with a bit of fieldwork, indeed. Our arrival had only stoked the island’s liveliness further, and the place was buzzing more than ever. As a result, Father and Lazy Pig had a word with the count and secured permission to open a circus on part of the marketplace. The plan was to keep the business running broadly, help with Big Sister’s village restoration, and take on the waves of the world one region at a time.
“Aaand so, it’s experiment time, nano!”
“What do you mean, experiment?!”

This time, we were at the altar deep in the innermost part of the island, where Calmadog appeared as the boss. The orb resting on this altar was the entrance to the inult-exclusive dungeon, I say. We had brought Keel along for the occasion. Ren, meanwhile, was still off clearing the dungeon.
“Come on, Keel-kun, give it a shot.”
“You can do it, Keel-kun!”
At Itsuki’s suggestion, Mole had joined in cheering Keel on as well, indeed. Even in this loop, Mole and Keel got along splendidly.
“Nah, I don’t wanna go in! I ain’t no inult!”
“Well… even if you’re not an inult, you might still get in just because you look similar.”
“Bro, that ain’t no help at all! Why do I gotta do this?!”
“Gathering intel on Gaelion and the others, nano.”
“What good’s knowing this gonna do?!”
Keel was yipping and yapping like a chained-up puppy, I say.
“Might be able to substitute for it in loops without Sword Hero, nano.”
“Don’t substitute me for that! Oi! Luna-chan! Don’t bring me anywhere near that thing!”
Luna-chan scooped Keel up and climbed the altar steps, indeed.
“Keel wasn’t around when the heroes’ fairy-transformation magic was discovered, nano. So, experiment, nano.”
“I really don’t wanna hear about some other world where I don’t exist, but that don’t mean you get to experiment on me!”
“Now, now, Keel-kun. Maybe it means only you and Ren can get into this dungeon out of all of us.”
“‘Exclusive,’ they say, but jeez…”
Despite all the grumbling, Keel eventually agreed to give it a try, indeed.
“No good. Something’s pushing me back, I can’t get in!”
“I see… guess it really is impossible, huh.”
“Shield Hero-sama, this.”
“Ah, right.”
Saying that, Father took the item Mole had produced and plopped it onto Keel’s head — a Santa hat, indeed.
“Bro, what are you— whoa!”
With a plop, Keel got sucked straight into the dungeon, I say. So it seemed she could enter after all.
“Well, guess the dungeon mistook her for one on account of the resemblance, nano. Or maybe Keel really is kin to the inults, nano.”
Experiment successful, nano! Rival declared, apparently satisfied with her verification.
“I ain’t happy about it! What’s the point of me going into the dungeon all alone?!”
“There’s treasure deeper in, nano. Keel can go play with Sword Hero later, nano.”
“Well, that being the case, do your best in there, Keel-kun.”
“…If we use the inult’s Class Up item on Keel, she might actually become an inult, nano.”
“Quit experimenting on me for real! Honestly!”

Amid such exchanges, our vacation on Cal Mira Island rolled steadily onward. Naturally, with the extension of the activation period now confirmed, the count wore a beaming grin at the thought of turning his time-limited income into a regular fixture.
“Yuki-chan, come over here, indeed! Vroom vroom!”
“Motoyasu-sama, please wait for me!”
In my usaunny form, I engaged Drive Mode and enjoyed a beachside rendezvous with Yuki-chan, indeed. Ahahaha… ufufufu… I say.
“Ho ho ho.”
The Sage, who had invited us to the island in the first place, watched the whole spectacle with evident delight, indeed.
“Well… I guess it’s visually acceptable if it’s in usaunny form?”
“By human standards, perhaps…”
“By demi-human standards it’s a little unsettling.”
Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy, standing near Father, took potshots at my Drive Mode, indeed. What complaints could they possibly have, I wonder?
“Vof-peen! Naofumi-sama, let’s play in the sea, peen!”

“Wolf sure is enjoying peckul form… picked up all sorts of special abilities too. Watching him scale the island slopes like that kind of reminds me of… I don’t know, some diet-themed game. Though there’s no horrible pink hen penguin around… come to think of it, she really was a horrible girlfriend.”
“I have no idea what Iwatani-sama is talking about.”
I didn’t know either, I say! Was he talking about the Crimson Swine, perhaps?
“Vof!”
Incidentally, it seemed Father had also had the peckul special ability transferred to him via dungeon clearing, following Wolf’s example.
“Yuki-chan, watch this, indeed! Put your left foot forward before your right foot sinks — that’s how you run across the sea, pyon!”
I went dashing across the waves with a tap-tap-tap, indeed.
“Whoa… what kind of joke is that. Running on top of the ocean.”
“Filo-tan did it too, with a boost from Father’s support magic, pyon!”
“Ah, so casting Liberation Aura makes it possible… that’s incredible.”
“I don’t even know what to call that.”
“Should Theo chase after them too? Might make for a nice picture, what with Motoyasu-kun being a rabbit.”
“Not sure joining in on that is such a great idea.”
“Depending on the running form, it might actually look good…”
I shall now pass down to you all the secret art of thoroughly enjoying Cal Mira Island, pyon!
“There’s other games too, pyoon! Watch this, pyon!” I raised my spear high into the sky and swung it down with all my might.
And with that, the sea split cleanly apart, pyon!
“Look, Yuki-chan! Seabed running, pyon! Run through and see the ocean floor before the water comes rushing back, pyon! It’s beautiful, pyon!”
“Yes, ma’am!”
“He’s parting the sea… even some famous commandments would be impressed.”
“Are we really okay just calling that ‘playing around’?”
“This area’s supposed to be shallow water anyway, so… I guess it’s not too much of a problem?”
“Ooh, looks like fun! Everyone, let’s go!”
“Yeah!”
Yuki-chan and the Filolial-sama who’d tagged along came chasing after me, indeed. What a delightfully fun game to play in the sea, I say!
“Really soaking it all in, huh… meanwhile Ren and Itsuki are stuck grinding away in the dungeon…”
“Ain’t nothing wrong with that, is there?”
Panda stood beside Father, a swim ring in hand and a snorkel perched on her head, indeed. Naturally, she was in a swimsuit.
“Lars-san, I don’t know where you even bought sunglasses or all this beach gear, but… you’re enjoying yourself as much as Elena-san does.”
“It’s a day off, ain’t it. Or is there some pressing need to grind Levels killing monsters ’round here?”

We had already well surpassed the necessary Level for this place, I say. In truth, there was little reason to be here beyond dungeon-clearing, but enjoying a vacation was reason enough in itself, indeed.
“This is a way of having fun too, in its own sense, nano. Gaelion’s going hunting with Big Sisters and the others, nano.”
“Everyone’s doing whatever they please… well, I suppose the goal of strengthening cooperation between heroes has already been achieved.”
“Doesn’t Shield Hero have anywhere he’d like to go? It can’t all be about watching over Spear Hero, can it?”
“That’s right, that’s right, let’s play, vof-peen!”
“Feels like the incident’s finally been resolved, don’t you think? Once it’s all over there’ll be plenty to handle, so let’s enjoy ourselves while we still can.”
And so, the three slaves made their pitch to Father, indeed.
